metadata.intro_narrative: You stand in the center of 'The Architect's' safe house, a hidden bunker belonging to the city's most elusive cryptographer who vanished three days ago. The room is cold, lit only by the hum of server racks and the blinking cursors of various terminals. The Architect left behind a masterpiece of digital security—a final message that reveals the location of the stolen prototype. However, the system is fragmented. To uncover the truth, you must trace the flow of data through his vintage equipment, processing the signal step-by-step until the final encryption breaks. The air is thick with the smell of ozone and old paper. Time is running out before the security override locks the system forever.
